therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: proteasome inhibition combined with DNA alkylation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: enhanced myeloma cell killing through dual mechanism conditioning regimen
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with relapsed multiple myeloma undergoing autologous stem cell transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: maximum tolerated dose and response rates (VGPR and CR)

results.effect_size: MTD 56 mg/m2, VGPR rate 26/45 (57.8%), CR rate 10/45 (22.2%)
safety_signals: 22/45 patients had grade 3-4 non-hematologic adverse events
results.dose_information: Carfilzomib MTD 56 mg/m2 on days -3 and -2, Melphalan 200 mg/m2 on day -2
